title: Define OS memory governance and knowledge quarantine
purpose: Define how AgentOS uses memory and knowledge while preventing poisoned context from becoming privileged OS behavior.
scope: Define memory scopes for session, run, audit-derived, ecosystem and quarantined content.
Define secret-like redaction and raw secret rejection.
Define planner context bounds and quarantine rules.
implementation_steps: Define what memory may enter Planner context.
Record evidence with memory poisoning examples.
acceptance_criteria: Untrusted knowledge cannot become privileged instruction.
Raw secrets are rejected or redacted.
Planner context remains bounded and labeled.
failure_modes: Knowledge pack writes trusted policy instruction.
Planner accepts memory as approval authority.
